recommendation: Keep the commit. It preserves the approved SHOULD-level derivation rules and later refinements while removing wording defects that impaired the clarity requested by FHIR-48481. Treat FHIR-52921 and FHIR-51717 as separate reconciliation work if needed.
issue_request: FHIR-48481 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6. It requested clearer rules for derived SearchParameters and OperationDefinitions, including SearchParameter.derivedFrom wording, precise compatibility expectations, SHOULD-level derivation rules for normative resources, and version-specific canonical-reference guidance.
initial_application: Commit 4b0ec846152125c2a4906230501aa515d46b2bdf, merged by HL7/fhir#3967, added the main OperationDefinition and SearchParameter derivation guidance plus canonical-reference comments. Follow-up commits 7d7aaa259cf026f8eb99548349474f9b7fc693a5 and 02f79b0a3ba639280ab7d0d92e364f0a2b676bea refined experimental-rule wording and ballot-note anchors. The source still retained issue-scoped wording defects: 'change add types', a non-existent OperationDefinition target reference, 'base observation', and 'definition from which it is defined'.
additional_context: FHIR-I WGM 202501 minutes confirm the 20-0-1 Persuasive with Modification vote and the modifications made to the proposed OperationDefinition and SearchParameter derivation guidance. Later FHIR-52921 added complementary OperationDefinition parameter/profile alignment guidance without reversing FHIR-48481. FHIR-49704 addressed a separate SearchParameter derivation workflow issue via an Extension Pack audit already present on the combined branch. No relevant Zulip discussion was found for FHIR-48481.
reconciliation: The commit fixes only the remaining issue-scoped defects in active core source: OperationDefinition narrative now says derived operations cannot 'change or add types', the derivation rule references OperationDefinition.resource rather than a non-existent target element, the optional-parameter bullet says base OperationDefinition rather than base observation, and SearchParameter.derivedFrom now says the definition from which it is derived. Generated SVG/rendered artifacts were not edited.
source_changes: source/operationdefinition/operationdefinition-notes.xml: corrected residual OperationDefinition derivation wording for type changes, the base resource element reference, and the base OperationDefinition optional-parameter bullet.
source/searchparameter/structuredefinition-SearchParameter.xml: corrected SearchParameter.derivedFrom definition text to say the search parameter is derived from the referenced definition.
